canon_rules: Kalenda/Calinda, bois, lavway, drums, and gayelle are core cultural anchors.
A stick has memory. A fighter has spirit. A drum has rhythm. A lavway has command. The gayelle binds them together.
Kai has an obsessive love of doubles and may need one before a fight.
Pilot starts narrator-led for speed; voice cast can be added later.
Season 1 must be fast-paced and cliffhanger-driven, built for a franchise audience across the whole Caribbean and global Black anime community.
Trinidad is the spark; the full Caribbean is the franchise map.
Marius Vale is Trinidad-born and diaspora-raised between London and Miami; he leads the Stillwater Order and believes forced unity through the False One Drum will end Caribbean division.
Marius is not random evil. His evil is forced unity: one rhythm, one command, memory theft, voice theft, and erased island identity.
The Stillwater Order includes Selah Vale, the Mute Boismen, the Echo Thieves, the Drumless, the Black Bell Sisters, and the Archivist of Silence.
Every episode needs a strong cliffhanger that expands the island map, deepens the mystery, or emotionally punishes a character choice.
